SASBDB entry SASDT55  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDT55/)

Publication: The NS1 protein of influenza B virus binds 5’-triphosphorylated dsRNA to suppress RIG-I activation and the host antiviral response
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1101/2023.09.25.559316

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDT55/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
